author: Phivanduc
quote: 13 **** years of waiting for GTA VI, just to get this steaming pile of ****. I tortured myself for 15 hours trying to force some enjoyment out of it, and I still couldn't. Plus, it doesn't have that GTA vibe at all, it feels like playing a completely different game. More like a criminal dating sim or something. Even worse, the game feels super restrictive. You can't buy houses or cars, you're only allowed to live with Lucia, with no way to live on your own and get away from her, constantly having to listen to that woman complaining and ****. You can't flirt with other women, and you can't just shoot freely anywhere. The open world feels like it's designed in a way that doesn't want players committing crimes (in my experience). The story and Jason's character are bland, playing as Lucia isn't exciting at all, and there's so much more.
